title: VESPER VerificationStrategy
description: REM-010 §4.2. A typed union bound to task class, in strength order. This type exists because IC-007's `verification_criteria` had no type, and an untyped acceptance condition is satisfied by any string -- including the empty one. Authority: RB-004, SR-013, SR-055; REM-010, DF-VERIFY-SELECT.

strategy.description: Strength order, strongest first. Independence is a property of the STRATEGY, not of the model count: a passing test suite is more independent than a second LLM and it runs on the weakest node offline.

required_support_types.description: `model_prior` is deliberately absent from this list. A claim supported only by a model prior cannot ground a verification (INV-EVID-1).

independent_context.description: Mandatory true. A critic sharing the generator's context is `self_model` wearing a stronger name, and the enum value it must then declare has different reporting obligations.

async_post_hoc.description: REM-010 §4.5: the critic may run asynchronously with honest post-hoc correction. This is how the AR-024 latency intersection is resolved without weakening verification.

acknowledged_no_independence.description: The field exists so that choosing the weakest strategy is an explicit act. INV-VERIF-3 forbids reporting it as accepted without this acknowledgement travelling with the result.

non_consequential_justification.description: Permitted ONLY for explicitly non-consequential output, and recorded as such -- never silently skipped. The mandatory justification is what stops `none_declared` becoming the default an implementer reaches for.

machine_checkable.description: DF-VERIFY-SELECT input. INV-VERIF-2: a FREE_TIME task whose acceptance condition is not machine-checkable is INELIGIBLE for autonomous completion and queues. Derived from `strategy`, not independently asserted: true for deterministic and retrieval_grounded, false otherwise.

$comment: The `strategy` tag and the `criteria.kind` tag must agree; the allOf block enforces it. Without that, a task could declare `deterministic` strength while carrying `self_model` criteria -- which is exactly how an implementation optimising for a green autonomy gate would satisfy INV-VERIF-2 while violating it.
